title: Foreign-owned limited liability company (PT PMA) via OSS
summary: Foreign-owned businesses generally operate in Indonesia through a PT PMA registered on the Online Single Submission (OSS) risk-based licensing system, which issues the Business Identification Number (NIB). Confirm whether a PT PMA, representative office or partner-led model fits the planned activities.
foreign_ownership_notes: Structure options depend on the KBLI business classification and the investment positive list.
instrument: Government Regulation 5/2021 on Risk-Based Business Licensing
reviewer_notes: Seeded from the official source homepage for the hackathon prototype. Needs professional review before reliance.

title: Business field classification and foreign ownership limits
summary: Foreign equity limits are set per business field (KBLI code) under the investment positive list. The startup must map each planned activity to a KBLI code before choosing a structure. Minimum investment and paid-up capital thresholds for PT PMA are set by BKPM regulation and have changed over time, so check the current figures.
foreign_ownership_notes: Some health services fields carry ownership conditions; software and data processing fields are generally more open. Verify per KBLI code.
instrument: Presidential Regulation 10/2021 as amended by 49/2021 (Investment Business Fields)
reviewer_notes: Seeded from the official source homepage for the hackathon prototype. Needs professional review before reliance.

title: Medical device and health software marketing authorisation
summary: Products classed as medical devices, which can include some diagnostic or clinical decision software, need a distribution permit (izin edar) from the Ministry of Health before sale or deployment. Whether an AI health application is a medical device depends on its intended use, so this needs professional review.
foreign_ownership_notes: Permits are typically held by a locally registered entity or appointed distributor.
instrument: Law 17/2023 on Health and Ministry of Health medical device regulations
reviewer_notes: Seeded from the official source homepage for the hackathon prototype. Needs professional review before reliance.

title: Health data platform integration for healthcare facilities
summary: Healthcare facilities in Indonesia are being required to integrate electronic medical records with the national SATUSEHAT platform. Startups selling into hospitals should check whether their product must interoperate with SATUSEHAT and what technical onboarding applies.
instrument: Minister of Health Regulation 24/2022 on Medical Records
reviewer_notes: Seeded from the official source homepage for the hackathon prototype. Needs professional review before reliance.

title: Electronic System Operator (PSE) registration
summary: Private operators of electronic systems that serve users in Indonesia, including apps and SaaS platforms, are expected to register as an Electronic System Operator with the ministry responsible for digital affairs.
foreign_ownership_notes: Foreign operators serving Indonesian users may also be in scope.
authority: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
instrument: Government Regulation 71/2019 on Electronic Systems and Transactions

title: Tax registration, corporate income tax and VAT
summary: A local entity registers for a Taxpayer Identification Number (NPWP), files corporate income tax and, above the VAT threshold, registers as a VAT-able entrepreneur. Cross-border service fees and royalties to the parent may attract withholding tax, subject to the Malaysia-Indonesia tax treaty.
foreign_ownership_notes: Transfer pricing documentation applies to related-party transactions.
instrument: Law 7/2021 on Harmonisation of Tax Regulations
reviewer_notes: Seeded from the official source homepage for the hackathon prototype. Needs professional review before reliance.

title: Investment incentives: tax holiday, tax allowance and R&D super deduction
summary: Indonesia offers fiscal incentives for qualifying investments, including tax holidays for pioneer industries, tax allowances, and an additional deduction for qualifying research and development. Eligibility depends on business field, investment size and location.
authority: Ministry of Investment / BKPM and Ministry of Finance
instrument: Ministry of Finance Regulation 153/2020 (R&D super deduction) and related incentive regulations
reviewer_notes: Seeded from the official source homepage for the hackathon prototype. Needs professional review before reliance.

title: Foreign worker utilisation plan (RPTKA)
summary: Employers hiring foreign staff need an approved Foreign Worker Utilisation Plan (RPTKA) from the Ministry of Manpower, pay the foreign worker levy, and generally assign Indonesian counterparts for knowledge transfer. Certain positions are closed to foreigners.
instrument: Government Regulation 34/2021 on Utilisation of Foreign Workers
reviewer_notes: Seeded from the official source homepage for the hackathon prototype. Needs professional review before reliance.

title: Work and stay permits (KITAS) and business visit visas
summary: Foreign founders and staff working in Indonesia need the appropriate visa and limited stay permit (KITAS), applied for online after RPTKA approval. Short business visits for meetings use a separate visit visa category that does not permit work.
instrument: Law 6/2011 on Immigration (as amended)
reviewer_notes: Seeded from the official source homepage for the hackathon prototype. Needs professional review before reliance.

title: Local employment and social security registration
summary: Employing local staff requires employment agreements compliant with Indonesian manpower law, registration with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (employment social security) and BPJS Kesehatan (health insurance), and payroll income tax withholding.
instrument: Law 6/2023 (Job Creation) amending Law 13/2003 on Manpower

title: Trademark and patent protection in Indonesia
summary: Indonesia is a first-to-file trademark jurisdiction, so register the brand with DJKI before launch. Software is mainly protected by copyright; patentability of software-implemented inventions is limited and needs specialist advice. Indonesia is a Madrid Protocol member.
foreign_ownership_notes: Foreign applicants file through a registered IP consultant.
instrument: Law 20/2016 on Trademarks; Law 13/2016 on Patents (as amended)
reviewer_notes: Seeded from the official source homepage for the hackathon prototype. Needs professional review before reliance.

title: Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP)
summary: The PDP Law sets lawful bases for processing, data subject rights, breach notification within 3x24 hours, and conditions for cross-border transfer. Health data is specific (sensitive) personal data with stricter obligations, which may require a data protection impact assessment and a data protection officer.
foreign_ownership_notes: Applies to processing outside Indonesia that affects Indonesian data subjects.
authority: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
instrument: Law 27/2022 on Personal Data Protection

title: Hospital procurement and pilot agreements
summary: Pilots with public hospitals may follow government procurement rules (including the e-catalogue), while private hospitals contract directly. Confirm the contracting entity, data sharing terms and whether the pilot needs ethics committee approval.
instrument: Presidential Regulation 16/2018 on Government Procurement (as amended)

foreign_ownership_notes: Most sectors allow 100% foreign ownership; some services sectors carry equity conditions.
